method: Complete original effect/component/projectile module review and renderer material-uniform dispatch source tracing. No renderer, GPU, browser, native window or OS input.

changes.point_size: Trail and Snowsplat use RawShaderMaterial explicit gl_PointSize. THREE refreshUniformsPoints applies DPR only to PointsMaterial, so native quad extents must divide by current physical framebuffer dimensions, not logical window size.
changes.ordering: EffectSystem adds Trail layer then Snowsplat layer. Native now emits all trail particles before all impacts. Within-layer ring-buffer indexing remains unfinished.
changes.arithmetic: Vertex elapsed/random calculations now cast uniform/attribute inputs to f32 before operations, and trail uses source literal PI=3.14159. Native still does not emulate GPU transcendental precision or pixel rasterization.
changes.visibility: Trail displayTime<=0 and impact displayTime<1 now suppressed like source fragments, plus existing duration end guards.

example_scope: Analytical viewport conversion, not observed GPU point coverage. Hardware point-size range/clamping/point coverage are not emulated by native quads.
unfinished: Fixed 500 trail / 2000 impact rings, persistent random-per-slot values, wrap/drop indexing, source pooled registration/removal and restart lifetime.
Source effect-stage enqueue/flush order and whole-match RNG consumption; native particles are still unbounded chronological emissions retained by age.
GPU point coverage/subpixel center rounding, point size hardware limits, effect texture orientation/minification and complete composite draw order.
General user texture-clarity report and all-scene parity remain unverified.

original_constructor_observation.scope: Original effect constructors and actual THREE transparent-list sort; no renderer or shader execution. Constant RNG .5 only initializes unused random attributes; no updates/gameplay/load IO executed.
